title: intent bootstrap --check's divergence note says the pointer's install runs the guards, when the running intent's install does
body:
Found by dc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit; dc's verifier drove it with a planted roster.

Seen: `intent bootstrap --check`'s divergence note (`render.rs:11869`) says the guards that run are the pointer's install's. As built, the gate body comes from the pointer, but the guard runner and its roster come from the running `intent`'s install, through `intent info` (`pre-commit.sh:94-102`, `:282`).

Expected: the note names where each part of the gate comes from.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- filed for after the stabilisation line; `intent/docs/pre-commit-hook.md` describes the as-built behaviour.
